title: JTAG and SWD overview: preserve debug access and reset states
summary: Choose the supported debug interface and connector. Check pin multiplexing, reset behavior and input bias before reusing debug pins.
applies_to: MCU debug interfaces; STM32F4 reset-state examples are device-specific.
required_inputs: Target/package, probe and intended debug/recovery access
verification: Verify connection under reset and after application startup.
limitations: Internal pull resistors differ by device; do not apply STM32F4 defaults to every target.

title: SWD connector and voltage-reference pattern
summary: Connect SWCLK, bidirectional SWDIO, ground and the probe voltage reference; provide target reset where required. SWO is optional trace, not required for basic SWD.
applies_to: Probe-to-target SWD; connector assignments depend on the probe adapter.
required_inputs: Probe pinout and target I/O voltage/reset requirements
verification: Check orientation and voltage-reference sensing before connecting the probe.
limitations: VTref is a sense/reference input on the cited J-Link connector, not an assumed target-power output.

pattern.diagram: Probe SWCLK -> target; SWDIO <-> target; target VIO -> probe VTref
routing: Use the actual adapter mapping; review reset loading.
pitfalls: Do not confuse the optional supply pin with VTref.

title: JTAG scan-chain connection pattern
summary: Chain each target TDO to the next target TDI; share TCK and TMS as specified. Configure the probe for the chain order and instruction-register lengths.
required_inputs: Device order, voltage domains and instruction-register lengths
verification: Verify enumeration and access to every target in the intended power state.
limitations: An unpowered or misconfigured target can prevent chain access. SWD is not wired as a JTAG serial chain.

citations.locator: JTAG interface; multiple devices and scan-chain configuration

pattern.diagram: Probe TDI -> A.TDI; A.TDO -> B.TDI; B.TDO -> probe TDO
placement: Plan access to the complete chain.
routing: Review shared-clock loading and reset requirements.
pitfalls: Do not wire target TDO outputs together.
